steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each result is placed by its sample size against the minimum of 50.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Result reported with no sample size
Segment below the minimum sample
findings.fix: Merge the segment or report it as indicative

findings.title: Change between waves with no significance check
findings.fix: Test the change before reporting it

pros: Checks a result reported with no sample size; a change between waves reported with no significance check; a group below the minimum sample size (default 50, set in the brief).
cons: Not checked: Survey design quality; sampling method.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mkt-brand-health skill on the records for this review.
